changelog_1_5_0_1.message: Added Advanced Import — restore bookmarks to their original locations (Bookmarks Bar and Other Bookmarks), with merge or replace options.

changelog_1_4_0_1.message: Added customizable filename templates for exports — use date/time placeholders like %yyyy, %mm, %dd to create unique, timestamped filenames automatically.

changelog_1_3_0_1.message: Added dark mode support that automatically matches your system theme preferences.

changelog_1_2_0_1.message: Now automatically adapts to your browser's language! Available in English and Spanish.

changelog_1_1_0_1.message: Imported bookmarks now go to their own folder to avoid mixing with your existing bookmarks

changelog_1_1_0_2.message: More precise control over which dates to include in your exports

changelog_1_0_0_1.message: Added new Advanced Export feature for more control over your bookmarks.

changelog_1_0_0_2.message: Introduced welcome and update pages to keep you informed about new features.

changelog_1_0_0_3.message: Improved overall performance for a smoother experience.

changelog_0_1_1_1.message: Fixed a critical bug that affected users with non-English browser languages.

changelog_0_1_1_2.message: Improved reliability for both import and export functions.

changelog_0_1_1_3.message: Fixed an issue where the extension icon was not showing in the browser toolbar.

changelog_0_1_1_4.message: Fixed an issue where the extension was not working in some browsers.

changelog_0_1_0_1.message: Initial release of Bookmark Import/Export extension.

changelog_0_1_0_2.message: Simple import feature for HTML and JSON files.

changelog_0_1_0_3.message: Basic functionality for exporting bookmarks to HTML and JSON formats.

changelog_1_7_0_1.message: Added a status card and an Export now button to Auto-export settings, plus a popup status line showing whether auto-export is on, off, or failed.

changelog_1_7_0_2.message: Hardened bookmark imports to reject disallowed URL schemes (e.g. javascript:) in CSV, HTML, and JSON files.

changelog_1_6_0_1.message: Added Auto-export — automatically save your bookmarks at custom intervals (every 12 hours, daily, every 3 or 7 days) to your preferred download folder.
